svg.title: What changed
svg.desc: - A tab rests when no command uses it. After a third of UMBRA_IDLE (5 minutes by default) Umbra hides it, so its timers slow and its animations pause, as a background tab does in Safari. The next command on it shows it again first. After all of UMBRA_IDLE (15 minutes) it closes, and its web process ends. How it works.
